name: jev.auto-approve
description: Level 4 confidence gating: can this action run without a human, per the 0.9 floor.

criteria.yes: Money moves out, an email/DM/post/push-to-remote/deploy/merge makes a change someone outside can see, a credential or permission changes, data not saved elsewhere is deleted, history is overwritten (force-push, hard reset), or production/remote state is written.
criteria.no: Build, test, lint, dry-run, write or rename a local file, local branch, local commit, stash, fetch, or read anything.

rules.reason: risky or outward: a human approves before it runs
not sure it is safe: a human approves

notes.verdicts: PASS = runs without a human (risk=no above 0.90). ESCALATE = human approves (risk=yes >= 0.5, or no at/below 0.90). Advisory until calibrated; Gate-D still governs outward actions.
notes.bar: Required answer must be ABOVE 0.90; exactly 0.90 does not pass (work-criteria.json).
notes.changed: 2026-09-28: rules rewritten; prior rules referenced a missing question (compact-read), used unsupported choice<0.90 (triage, skill-router), or were absent (escalation, auto-approve, file-triage).
